widgets_values:
Aesthetic: Cinematic real-time 3D game rendering, vertical portrait video, soft golden hour outdoor lighting, shallow depth of field, warm natural atmosphere, subtle film grain
[SHOT 1]
Duration: 0:00 - 0:06
Camera Motion: Slow subtle push-in, minimal gentle vertical sway
Visual Prompt: Starting from the reference frame. Beautiful young woman with extra long straight black hair, glowing amber-red eyes, wearing glossy blue zip-up camisole dress with black lace trim, blue crystal pendant necklace and tiny teardrop earrings. She stands in a sunlit wild daisy meadow, faint breeze stirs strands of her long hair, faint soft smile on her face, she slowly tilts her head slightly and blinks gently, warm sunset light wraps around her shoulders, background flower field softly blurred.
Audio / Dialogue: Gentle light wind rustling, quiet ambient meadow sounds 轻柔女声 人声："风刚好停在这里了。"
[SHOT 2]
Duration: 0:06 - 0:12
Camera Motion: Slow slight clockwise orbit, keeps character centered
Visual Prompt: Starting from the reference frame. The woman shifts her gaze softly, her hair continues to drift lightly in the wind, sunlight creates soft rim light along her hair outline, wild white daisies sway gently in the background meadow, subtle highlights glint on the blue fabric of her dress and crystal necklace. She relaxes her shoulders, maintains a calm tender expression.
Audio / Dialogue: Continuous soft wind sound, distant faint insect chirps 轻柔女声 人声："这片花海，安静得刚刚好。"

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
